items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled out for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; Tanner McKee expected to start with Joe Milton signed for depth.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in small clot originally found pre-London game; team prioritizing health after he played through it in Week 5.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense total drops, pass-catchers and Barkley face uncertainty with backup QB.
items.opportunity: Increased volume potential for Eagles skill players if McKee airs it out, but overall efficiency risk.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) officially ruled out again for Sunday vs Patriots; third straight miss.
items.why: Continued DNP Wednesday/Thursday with quad; confirmed by coach/reports.
items.implication: Backup inherits nearly full backfield snaps/carries again.
items.opportunity: Near-100% snap share and high touch volume for primary backup in favorable spot.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and ruled OUT vs Jaguars.
items.why: Groin injury; no travel for London game.
items.implication: Full RB snaps/touches to remaining backs, primarily Marks.
items.opportunity: Near-monopoly on Texans RB opportunities for the week.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley no practice again Thursday (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited.
items.implication: Game-time or out risk; Pierce/others if inactive.
items.opportunity: If OUT, goal-line/third-down to backups; Smith limited but progressing.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson DNP again Thursday (ankle) but earlier reports of realistic chance to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.why: Ankle; day-to-day with positive prior intel.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; Huntley if out hits Flowers etc.
items.opportunity: If out, backup QB limits ceiling for pass catchers.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start vs Falcons after hamstring.
items.implication: Bears offense upgrade; skill players rise.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Mike Evans as WR4 this week vs Commanders secondary; high target share and Deebo absence boost.
items.why: Season-high target share recently; Washington defense buffet for WRs; Deebo out multi-week.
items.implication: Elite WR1 upside in favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets with thin WR room behind him.

items.text: Berry loves Drake London as WR6 vs Bears; bankable usage.
items.why: Consistent high usage and favorable spot.

items.text: Berry hates Jaylen Waddle as WR28 vs Seahawks; production heavily concentrated in one game, poor otherwise.
items.why: 67% of yards in one game; averaging low yards otherwise; tough matchup.

items.text: Berry loves Kyren Williams as RB5 vs Cardinals; elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
items.why: Monster volume and favorable defensive matchup.

items.text: Berry loves Rhamondre Stevenson as RB9 vs Jets; volume spike with Henderson multi-week out.
items.why: 85% snaps/23 touches in prior Henderson absence; strong PPG when >15 touches.
items.implication: RB2 with RB1 upside this week.
items.opportunity: Expanded carries, third-down, red-zone with Henderson sidelined multi-week.

items.text: Levitan notes in two full games since Breece Hall injury: Braelon Allen 90 snaps, Isaiah Davis 12, others 0—snaps fully to Allen.
items.implication: Backup is every-down back until Hall returns.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route/carry share for lead backup.

items.text: Levitan notes Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins/McNabb/etc); Saquon turns 30 in Feb—if contender with RB need, call; agrees risk of too early better than too late.
items.why: Age/precedent for early exits; current hamstring DNP adds risk.
items.implication: ROS value watch; potential trade candidate if Eagles struggle.

items.text: Berry hates Emeka Egbuka (WR34) and Kyle Pitts (TE18) due to shaky QB/usage and tough spots.
items.why: Struggled for targets recently; poor matchups/QB play.
